value.rationale: The seven initial squares mark the exact first failure of the two-sum Sidon condition. A sharp ordered-coefficient fourth moment and the all-seven positive equality profile distinguish monotone polynomial-spectral norms from unrestricted collision norms. The result is a natural boundary case for a recent coefficient-constrained Fourier problem, not an arbitrary slice.
